FAQ page draft:

**How fast do you ship?** Orders placed before 14:00 ship the same working day from Utrecht. NL 1-2 days, BE/DE 2-4 days.
**Can I return something?** Yes, within 30 days. Free within the Netherlands. See the returns page.
**What size is the beanie?** One size. It stretches to fit 54-60 cm heads.
**How do I wash linen?** 40°C, gentle cycle, line dry. It softens with every wash.
**Do you gift wrap?** Yes, add a note at checkout and we wrap it in recycled paper for free.

Want it live and linked from the footer?
The FAQ is live at /pages/faq and linked in the footer between Shipping and Returns.
Understood. Say when you want to wrap up.
